analytics_profiles.notes: The live-verified nvdsanalytics probe path (P3.5 metadata, P4-B/C/D/E observations). Geometry: operator-saved dashboard geometry when present (P6-C, lineage-verified P6-D), else the probe-default central ROI + midline fallback. Line crossings run mode=loose — supports_direction stays false until strict-direction rules are implemented (nvdsanalytics dirStatus labels are surfaced as lineage only). Zone-transition quality is bounded by detector quality, not API validation.
